# Ezra TLV (עזרא תל אביב)

> Exclusive private event space and private bar in Florentin, Tel Aviv (Abarbanel 38). One event per evening - the entire space belongs to a single group. Up to 50 guests. All-inclusive: taboon/chef food, open cocktail bar, sound, lighting and full production. 800+ events, 40,000+ guests, 5.0★ (131 Google reviews).

Ezra TLV is a private bar that opens only for your group that night. It is not a banquet hall and not a restaurant open to the public. Last updated: 2026-08-20.

## What Ezra is
- A private bar that runs only for your group that night - not a banquet hall, not a restaurant.
- Best for: company events (team-building / department events), birthdays, engagements, private parties. 20–50 guests.
- Location: Abarbanel 38, Florentin, Tel Aviv, Israel.
- Contact: WhatsApp [+972-50-9499241](https://wa.me/972509499241) · Instagram [@ezratlv](https://www.instagram.com/ezratlv) · [eylam@ezratlv.com](mailto:eylam@ezratlv.com)

## Company event packages (final price per person, bookable online)
- [Happy Hour](https://ezratlv.com/company-events) - 3 hours, light buffet, wine + 2 beers - ₪275 per person
- [גיבוש מחלקה (department bonding, most popular)](https://ezratlv.com/company-events) - 5 hours, rich buffet, full bar - ₪330 per person
- [מסיבת חברה פרימיום (premium company party)](https://ezratlv.com/company-events) - 5 hours, premium buffet, open cocktail bar, DJ - ₪450 per person
- [Custom track](https://ezratlv.com/company-events) - fully tailored, including hosting at the company's own location

## Booking
Self-serve on the [company events page](https://ezratlv.com/company-events): pick a package, see live date availability, pick a menu, set guest count, get a final price on screen, and receive a contract by email. Response within 24 hours.
